paragraphs: Hey, what up? It's Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James. I'm writing this to all of you who are loved by God the Father and kept safe by Jesus. You're the ones God loves and Jesus keeps safe. So chill, everything's gonna be alright. Open your hearts, 'cause love is on the way!
§Fight with All You Have in You

I really wanted to write to you guys about the awesome salvation we all share. But I gotta switch gears and get real for a sec. You need to fight with all you've got for the faith that was given to us. It's a precious gift, so guard it like a treasure. Here's the deal: some suspicious people have snuck into our group. The Bible actually warned us this would happen. These guys might act all holy, but they're actually shameless phonies. They're trying to twist God's amazing grace into a free pass to do whatever they want. That means they're basically trying to cancel Jesus, our one and only Master.

I'm gonna lay it all out for you, even though you probably already know this stuff. Remember how the Lord saved our people from Egypt? Well, later on, he had to destroy those who turned their backs on him. And you've heard the story of the angels who ditched their posts for some shady business. Now they're locked up in darkness, waiting for Judgment Day. And don't forget about Sodom and Gomorrah. Those cities went completely off the rails, and now they're a permanent warning to everyone else. They're still burning, but they never burn up.
These new guys are on the same path. They're all about dirty stuff, they have no respect for authority, and they're dragging God's glory through the mud.

Even the archangel Michael, when he was arguing with the devil over Moses' body, didn't dare to condemn him with a curse. He just said, "The Lord will take care of you." But these guys? They mock whatever they don't understand. They live like animals, doing whatever they feel like, and they're heading for destruction. I'm so over them. They're following the same path as Cain, they're greedy like Balaam, and they're rebellious like Korah. They're a total mess.

These people are like a stain on our love feasts. They're shameless and just looking out for themselves. They're like clouds without rain, trees without fruit, and wild waves that leave nothing but foam. They're like lost stars heading for a dark abyss.

Enoch, who was the seventh from Adam, prophesied about them, saying, "Look, the Lord is coming with thousands of his holy angels to judge everyone. He's going to call out every single person for their wicked acts and for all the trash they've talked about him." These guys are nothing but complainers and whiners, always trying to get the biggest slice of the pie. They talk big, but they'll say anything to get ahead.

But you, my dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ told you. They said that in the last days, there would be people who make a joke out of everything and follow their own evil desires. These are the people who divide churches and think only of themselves. They have no sign of the Holy Spirit in them.

But you, my friends, need to build yourselves up in your most holy faith. Pray in the Holy Spirit, stay in God's love, and be ready for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ. That's the real life, the life that never ends.
Be gentle with those who are struggling with their faith. Go after those who have lost their way. Be kind to sinners, but don't be soft on sin. Sin stinks, and you need to stay away from it.

And now, all glory to the one who can keep you from falling and bring you into his glorious presence with great joy. To the only God our Savior, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, majesty, power, and authority, before all time, now, and forever. Amen.
